instruction.text: Complete the sentence with the missing word.

atoms.a: I like all fruit except for papaya.
atoms.b: I like all fruit ((except)) for papaya.

atoms.a: If I were especially clever, I would make sure not to forget my parent’s birthdays.
atoms.b: If I were ((especially)) clever, I would make sure not to forget my parents’ birthdays.

atoms.a: My brother always picks excellent melons. They’re perfectly ripe and sweet.
atoms.b: My brother always picks ((excellent)) melons. They’re perfectly ripe and sweet.

atoms.a: My little sister dropped her ice cream cone and the results were disastrous.
atoms.b: My little sister dropped her ice cream cone and the results were ((disastrous)).

atoms.a: My grandpa refuses to accept that he’s deaf and still goes to concerts.
atoms.b: My grandpa refuses to ((accept)) that he’s deaf and still goes to concerts.

atoms.a: I like to express myself in different ways: sometimes I dance, sometimes I sing, sometimes I even shout!
atoms.b: I like to ((express)) myself in different ways: sometimes I dance, sometimes I sing, sometimes I even shout!

atoms.a: I accidentally forgot to walk my brother home from school and got in big trouble.
atoms.b: I ((accidentally)) forgot to walk my brother home from school and got in big trouble.

atoms.a: I think you should examine that cheese more closely before eating it.
atoms.b: I think you should ((examine)) that cheese more closely before eating it.
